messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

I can help you restore service and then fix the MMS issue. First, I need to identify your account. Please provide one of the following:
- The phone number for the line having the issue, or
- Your customer ID, or
- Your full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)

Once I have that, I'll check your line status and roaming settings, then guide you through the steps to restore service and get MMS working.

Your phone shows no SIM card detected, and there is no cellular service or signal. Mobile data is enabled, but data roaming is not enabled. Since the SIM card is missing, this could be the main reason why you cannot send MMS or have proper mobile data service. Could you please confirm if your SIM card is properly inserted? If you want, I can help you simulate removing and reinserting the SIM card.

Please perform the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
